title: Type One Energy
summary: US fusion company developing stellarator reactors.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Type One Energy designs stellarators, a fusion configuration that uses complex twisted magnets to confine plasma steadily. It is working with utilities on siting and has government support. Stellarator construction is difficult, but steady-state operation is attractive.

Technology Exposure

  • Stellarator fusion reactors
  • Magnet design
  • Utility partnerships

What To Watch

  • Magnet fabrication
  • Demonstration schedule
  • Funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
